supabase.about: The Supabase project behind Suggest Edits (supabase/README.md). The address and key are public: the key only lets visitors do what supabase/schema.sql allows. starts_robot is true once Supabase starts the robot (supabase/robot.sql); the robot then opens an issue if those starts stop.
